items.title: Example of Detection of Linkage (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Example of Detection of Linkage: a main subheading of 18.6.1 Gene Linkage, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 101-102.

blocks.text: American biologist Thomas Hunt Morgan ne Drosophila mein do khasiyatein dekhin: paron (wings) ki lambai aur pait (abdomen) ki chaurai. Lambe paron ka allele (L) chhote ya vestigial (adhoore) paron (l) par dominant hai, aur chaure pait ka allele (B) patle pait (b) par dominant hai. Morgan ne yeh cross kiya:

blocks.caption: Morgan ka cross: walidain aur F1

blocks.text: Phir us ne F1 ki do makkhiyon ka aapas mein cross kiya. Nataij neeche ke figure mein hain.
Nateeje ki wazahat: law of independent assortment ke mutabiq F2 mein yeh 9:3:3:1 ratio honi chahiye thi:

blocks.caption: Independent assortment ke mutabiq mutawaqqa F2

blocks.text: Lekin Morgan ne F2 mein sirf parental milap dekhe: 3/4 makkhiyan lambe par aur chaure pait wali, aur 1/4 vestigial par aur patle pait wali.

blocks.alt: Makkhiyon aur un ke chromosome joron (dairon mein) ke saath cross. Walidain: lambe par, chaura pait LLBB x vestigial par, patla pait llbb. Sab gametes mein L-B ya l-b. F1: do LlBb makkhiyon ka cross; har aik L-B aur l-b gametes banati hai. F2 genotypes: 1/4 LLBB, 1/4 LlBb, 1/4 LlBb, 1/4 llbb. F2 phenotypes: 3/4 lambe par chaura pait, 1/4 vestigial par patla pait.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.10: Drosophila mein gene linkage (kitab ki Figure 18.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Parents, Gametes (All), F1, Gametes, F2 Genotype, F2 Phenotype, Long wing, broad abdomen, Vestigial wing, narrow abdomen.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har daire mein makkhi ka chromosome jora hai. L aur B aik hi chromosome par, aur l aur b doosre par hain. Is liye gametes sirf L-B ya l-b le kar jate hain, kabhi L-b ya l-B nahi. F2 mein LLBB, LlBb, LlBb aur llbb bante hain: 3/4 lambe par chaura pait aur 1/4 vestigial par patla pait; koi naya milap nahi.
Is data se Morgan ne nateeja nikala ke paron ki lambai aur pait ki chaurai ke genes aik hi chromosome par hain aur woh azad ho kar alag nahi hote.

blocks.prompt: Aik testcross mein dono parental qismein 42% har aik aur dono nayi qismein 8% har aik aati hain. Yeh kya dikhata hai?
blocks.explanation: Parental qismein naye se kahin zyada hain, is liye genes linked hain; lekin nayi qismein bhi aa rahi hain, yaani crossing over kabhi kabhi unhein alag karta hai: yeh incomplete linkage hai.

items: Aik hi chromosome ke genes linked hain aur ikatthe aage jate hain.
1:1:1:1 linked nahi; parental zyada aur naye kam incomplete linkage; sirf parental complete linkage.
Morgan: mutawaqqa 9:3:3:1 ke bajaye F2 mein sirf parental qismein, 3 : 1; genes aik chromosome par.
